caption: The drawing depicts an ornate stage set framed by elaborate gold decorations and deep red curtains. At the top corners, there are two golden cherub statues. Gold garlands hang from the upper section of the frame, which is intricately detailed with swirling, leaf-like patterns. The stage floor is a checkerboard pattern of pink and beige tiles. In the foreground on the stage are four balls in different colors and patterns: orange and white, red and white, blue and white, and plain blue. Two seals are present, one balancing a blue ball on its nose and the other facing the stage. There is a table or platform in the center adorned with a blue and gold cloth, where various objects are placed, including the patterned balls and small flags such as an American flag. Behind the stage, the background is an outdoor scene showing a stone staircase on the right, a central water fountain with a sculpted shell and flowing water, blooming pink and purple flowers, green hedges, bushes, and several tall trees. In the distance, there are rolling hills and a soft, light sky. The overall color palette includes reds, golds, blues, pinks, greens, and earth tones.
title: Vaudeville Stage Set
